scenarios.title: Morning brief
scenarios.preconditions: Marketer is signed in and Workfront is connected
scenarios.inputDescription: Free text; optional campaign or project
scenarios.expectedFailureDescription: No tasks are ready, with the statuses checked; or Workfront not reachable and nothing changed

sourceRecord.Example user input: What needs my attention for the finance activation?
sourceRecord.Input data: Free text; optional campaign or project
sourceRecord.Preconditions: Marketer is signed in and Workfront is connected
sourceRecord.What the system does: Lists tasks in Ready for activation for the marketer's projects, groups the finance ones, and summarises the campaign window and priorities
sourceRecord.ChatGPT (apps, MCP client): Action: sends the question. Response: shows the summary text and campaign card
sourceRecord.Activation app (Node.js, MCP SDK): Action: runs list_activation_tasks as the signed-in marketer. Response: ready tasks as structured data
sourceRecord.Workfront (MCP server): Action: list tasks in Ready for activation. Response: task IDs, names, journey keys, statuses
sourceRecord.Output shown in ChatGPT: Short summary, a campaign card (two finance journeys, one plan; activation window; channels) and the list of ready tasks with ID, name, journey key and status
sourceRecord.Error or exception output: No tasks are ready, with the statuses checked; or Workfront not reachable and nothing changed

inputMessage.text: What needs my attention for the finance activation?

response.text: Two finance journeys are ready for review. Start with Finance webinar nurture; its email and SMS drafts are available in this fixture.

scenarios.preconditions: A task list has been shown
scenarios.expectedFailureDescription: Task is missing journey key, list or draft IDs, so it is shown as Blocked with the reason

sourceRecord.Workfront (MCP server): Action: read the task and its custom fields. Response: field values, owner, due date
sourceRecord.Output shown in ChatGPT: Task detail card with a warning for each missing field
sourceRecord.Error or exception output: Task is missing journey key, list or draft IDs, so it is shown as Blocked with the reason

inputMessage.text: Show me the task for the finance webinar nurture

response.text: Finance webinar nurture is Ready for activation. Review its journey key, audience list, channel drafts, owner and due date.

scenarios.title: Build the audience plan
scenarios.preconditions: Direction confirmed; the Marketo list exists
scenarios.inputDescription: Task ID; Marketo list ID or lead IDs; channels; draft asset IDs
scenarios.expectedFailureDescription: Marketo list empty or not found; a contact with no email shown as contact eligibility missing; rate limited, retry offered

sourceRecord.Example user input: Build the plan for Top 20 buying groups and the wider finance audience.
sourceRecord.Input data: Task ID; Marketo list ID or lead IDs; channels; draft asset IDs
sourceRecord.Preconditions: Direction confirmed; the Marketo list exists
sourceRecord.What the system does: Pulls leads, checks consent and eligibility, keeps Top 20 on the tailored path and removes duplicates from the wider list, and reads draft status
sourceRecord.ChatGPT (apps, MCP client): Action: sends the request. Response: shows narrative, counts, audience table, draft status and buttons
sourceRecord.Activation app (Node.js, MCP SDK): Action: runs build_audience_plan: checks eligibility, keeps Top 20 on the tailored path, removes duplicates. Response: plan ID, counts, rows, drafts
sourceRecord.Plan store (Redis or Postgres): Action: creates the plan with recipients and draft references. Response: plan ID
sourceRecord.Marketo (REST API): Action: get leads by list or IDs, paged. Response: lead rows with email, consent flags, account tier and buying role
sourceRecord.AEM Assets (Assets Author API): Action: read each draft's metadata. Response: name, channel, approval status, version
sourceRecord.Output shown in ChatGPT: A sentence on how Top 20 overlaps the wider audience, counts (total, ready, excluded), an audience table (contact, account, buying role and tier, eligibility, decision button) and draft status per channel
sourceRecord.Error or exception output: Marketo list empty or not found; a contact with no email shown as contact eligibility missing; rate limited, retry offered

inputMessage.text: Build the plan for Top 20 buying groups and the wider finance audience.

response.text: Audience plan prepared: 412 unique contacts, 371 ready, 19 excluded and 22 held. 38 overlapping contacts remain on the tailored Top 20 path.

scenarios.title: Resolve an account match
scenarios.preconditions: A contact was flagged with an ambiguous account

sourceRecord.Error or exception output: Flagged for the identity owner when it cannot be resolved here

inputMessage.text: Use Harborline Bank for this contact.

response.text: Harborline Bank is noted as the preferred match for Jordan Brook in the plan only. The contact remains held until the identity owner resolves the match at source.

scenarios.title: Send (activate)
scenarios.expectedFailureDescription: Drafts changed since approval, so re-approve; AEP rejected some events, with the number sent and a note that resuming is safe; plan already activated

sourceRecord.What the system does: Re-checks draft status and version, sends one event per person per channel, and updates the Workfront task
sourceRecord.ChatGPT (apps, MCP client): Action: sends the click. Response: shows progress, then counts sent per channel and any skips
sourceRecord.Activation app (Node.js, MCP SDK): Action: runs activate_plan: re-checks drafts, sends one event per person per channel, retries safely. Response: sent and skipped counts
sourceRecord.Plan store (Redis or Postgres): Action: records the send status per recipient and channel. Response: updated statuses
sourceRecord.Workfront (MCP server): Action: set the task status and add a note with counts. Response: updated task
sourceRecord.Fusion (scenarios): Action: later receives delivery callbacks (scenarios 2 and 3). Response: stored results
sourceRecord.AEM Assets (Assets Author API): Action: re-read each draft's status and version before sending. Response: unchanged or changed
sourceRecord.AEP (HTTP streaming API): Action: accept one activation event per person per channel. Response: accepted or schema error
sourceRecord.AJO B2B (journey): Action: start the journey for each event and send email or SMS after consent checks. Response: send results by callback
sourceRecord.Output shown in ChatGPT: Progress, then a summary: events sent per channel, contacts skipped as ineligible, task status updated
sourceRecord.Error or exception output: Drafts changed since approval, so re-approve; AEP rejected some events, with the number sent and a note that resuming is safe; plan already activated

inputMessage.text: Send it.

response.text: Simulated activation accepted 491 events: 371 email and 120 SMS for 371 eligible contacts. 41 contacts were skipped. Nothing was actually sent.
